fields.statement: Verifier at 9d6f60e8: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestHealthAutonomyRisk -v -count=1 passes its three subtests: flagged plan (state warn, summary has 'outside text reaches agents with no permission checks', exactly one 'workflow plan runs from a queued request with bypassed permissions in interview' detail line, Next 'rhiza guide workflows'), nothing flagged (ok, no Next, no phrase, no workflow detail), flagged while paused (warn, 'daemon paused; ' prefix plus phrase, Next stays 'rhiza daemon set rhiza.daemon.paused false'). go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/health -count=1 passes, including health-risk-warning: rhiza health exits 0 with 'warn autonomy ... outside text reaches agents...' and the detail line, --json shows part autonomy state warn, and acceptEdits clears it. Read the diff: healthAutonomy calls requestExposedWorkflows, adds one ExposureDetail per exposed workflow (name, trigger, bypassing steps), never sets bad, and the paused branch runs last so it keeps its Next. Full internal/api package: every test PASS; the run reported only the root guard's .rhiza-root/usage.live.json change, written by the live root daemon, not by this diff.
